seoTitle: Article Schema Generator: BlogPosting and NewsArticle JSON-LD
metaDescription: Generate Article, NewsArticle or BlogPosting JSON-LD with ISO 8601 dates, authors with profile links and publisher. Checks date validity.
intro: Generates Article, NewsArticle or BlogPosting markup with headline, images, dates with time zone, authors linked to a profile page, and publisher.
why:
Dates are the usual trouble in article markup. Search engines want ISO 8601, ideally with a time zone, and a plain "15 January 2026" is not that. You type 2026-01-15 09:30 and set the offset once; the tool outputs a valid value and warns when a time has no zone, when the date is not real, or when the modified date is before the published date.

Each author line becomes a Person with a URL, so the author page can be referenced from other markup. Google lists no required properties for Article, only recommended ones, and the tool shows which of those are missing.
howTo: Fill headline, images, dates and one author: line per author.
Set the time zone offset if your times have none.
Copy the script tag into the article page.

faq.a: BlogPosting for blog posts, NewsArticle for news, Article otherwise. Google treats them alike for article results.
ISO 8601, for example 2026-01-15T09:30:00+01:00. A date without a time stays a date.
Google gives no hard limit. Keep it close to the visible page title.
